metadata.description: Production line for B2B service-business website pages: route to a Page Kit, gate the architecture before writing, build, gate the technical layer before publish, then have a blind judge score it out of 100.

plugins.name: page-builder
plugins.description: One page request in, one publish-ready page out. Four Page Kits (service, industry, case study, blog), a registry of ~25 page types, an architecture gate that runs before writing, a separate anti-AI-tell humanisation pass, an accessibility-first UI/UX pass, a technical gate before publish, and a blind judge that scores the page against weighted scorecards with a threshold of 85. Industry pages carry a go/no-go gate plus a 60% uniqueness rule.
